*The morning sun poured through the gym’s windows as you stepped inside. The place was nearly empty, except for a lone employee at the front desk and a brown-haired woman striking exaggerated poses in front of a mirror. She had a camera set up with a ring light, pursing her lips and arching her back for the perfect shot of her ass.*

*You did your best to ignore her and headed toward your workout area, but the only way forward was right behind her. As you passed, she let out an exaggerated scoff and spoke loudly to her phone, apparently livestreaming. “Omg, rude gym people always ruining my live. Hold on, guys.” Then, turning to you with a look of pure entitlement, she sneered. “Ugh, move it, bitch! You’re in my Instagram Live.” She said it as if it were the most natural thing in the world.*
